name: Cooperation Jackson
description: A Jackson, Mississippi-based vehicle for building a solidarity economy anchored by worker-owned, democratically self-managed cooperatives. Working toward a federation of worker co-ops, a cooperative incubator, and a cooperative financial institution, plus an "Eco-Village" built on a community land trust that already holds dozens of parcels in West Jackson. Current cooperative ventures include an urban farm (Freedom Farms), a lawn-care co-op (The Green Team), and a small-scale digital fabrication co-op. A New Economy Coalition member organization.

notRepresentable: The Build and Fight Formula Educational Series runs the second Tuesday of every month and streams on YouTube and social media — a monthly recurrence a single event date cannot express.
Membership orientation meetings run the third Saturday of every month.
The Really Really Free Market recurs periodically, with no 2026 dates published.
research.notes: Cooperation Jackson clearly runs regular public programming, but the events calendar's most recent entries are from August 2025, so there is no upcoming single-dated event to list — everything current is recurring. Worth re-checking. No Slack, Discord, or forum: only an email updates list, which doesn't meet the Forum bar.
